note: Majority: null. The Civil Code in force in Cameroon was not read (no official copy found; the ministry of employment's site minefop.gov.cm answered with a short page carrying no law texts). Work: Loi n° 92/007 du 14 août 1992 portant Code du travail, art. 86(1): children may not be employed in any undertaking, even as apprentices, before fourteen, save a derogation by order (arrêté) of the Minister of Labour, given local circumstances and the tasks they may be asked to do; art. 86(2) on young people at sea. Read in FAOLEX's copy of the text as compiled by Droit-Afrique (a private compiler of the official text; the ILO's own copy at ilo.org/dyn/travail answered 404 and NATLEX is behind Cloudflare). Performers: the Code makes no exception for performing; art. 86's derogation is a general ministerial order, not a permit for a child, so the form holds barred (my reading); whether an order lets children under 14 perform was not read. Service: null. No defence law or ministry page was read.

sources.title: Cameroun, Code du travail (Loi n° 92/007 du 14 août 1992), text compiled by Droit-Afrique, FAOLEX
sources.said: Les enfants ne peuvent être employés dans aucune entreprise, même comme apprentis, avant l’âge de quatorze ans, sauf dérogation accordée par arrêté du ministre chargé du Travail, compte tenu des circonstances locales et des tâches qui peuvent leur être demandées.
